messages.subject: FDR correction SEM
parts:
Hi everyone,

For my hypotheses I ran 8 Random-Intercept Crosslagged Panel Models (RI-CLPM). I ran 8 because I used different measures of mental wellbeing (stress, depression, anxiety, specific stress) per model, creating 4 models, with 2 different outcome measures (food total, food specific groups), creating 8 models.  I wondered if it is recommend now to adjust for multiple testing, as I look at all associations individually. I feel that it might be good to correct for spurious findings. Is this correct?

And if so, I wanted to use FDR with the function in R p.adjust. Do I add all p-values of all 8 models to one vector and then use the function to look at all adjusted values? I first thought to only add significant values, but I am afraid it does not give you good corrected p-values, is this true? 

Or is there another way to adjust for multiple testing with SEM if this is necessary? 

Thank you in advance!

Best,
Nina
